title: The Beloved (SFF2026)
synopsis:
The acclaimed film director Esteban Martínez returns home with a new film, casting his struggling actress daughter Emilia as the lead. While it seems like a chance to help her career and mend their broken relationship, the high-pressure film set exposes his volatile, controlling nature. Driven by intense confrontations and raw performances, this masterclass in psychological tension explores deep family scars, hidden resentment, and a desperate, lingering longing to truly be loved.

 

Cannes Film Festival

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
國際知名導演回國籌備新作，邀請半紅不黑的演員女兒擔演主角，扶助對方事業是藉口，修補疏離已久的父女關係才是真正意圖。片場不對等的權力關係，拍攝衝突將導演的狂躁與失序控制欲曝露人前，荒漠風沙揚起女兒塵封心底的鬱結愛恨。蘇洛高恩以聲畫處理放大情感張力，以開首一場近20分鐘父女重逢對話戲特寫赤裸對峙，為僵持關係定調。哈維爾巴頓又一代表作：細膩表情遂層流露內心拉扯，窒息的情感空間，背負着極力掩藏的傷疤、怨恨和被愛的渴望。
